Problem: Fallout4 - Nvflex.ba2
Summary: Nvidia Flex is enabled in your game INIs (bNVFlexEnable=1) but the Nvflex BA2 is missing.
The exe is hardcoded to load this BA2.
Solution: Verify files with Steam or reinstall the game.
If you downgraded the game you will need to do so again afterward.

Problem: 150 SADD Records from 3 modules
Summary: Counts race animation subgraph records (RACE \ SADD).
Depending on your PC, adding too many of these may result in stutter when loading Cells.
This issue needs more investigation as this may be mere correlation and not causation.
Solution: IF you are experiencing stutter when moving between cells, removing some of these mods could alleviate performance issues.
Merging them may also reduce stutter.
